method: Code Doctor evidence-first debugging; REA static WBCode/original-source comparison; independent read-only source review. Not a complete application/security audit.
checks: All real app enqueue paths pin circulation per job in the same SQLite transaction; global profile unchanged; no exposed opt-in.
Legacy and ambiguous submissions require existing original profile, full exact order/quantity/CIS identity; observer uses strict ownership proof and no remote mutation.
Missing/foreign owner or incomplete/unknown readback never marks stock available.
Timeout/5xx/historically misleading REJECTED labels do not authorize duplicate legal submissions; known external ids remain polled.
Remote SUZ status is preserved through local order transitions; new explicit remote observations overwrite it.
CIS readback precedes Catalog/new-document metadata; missing TN remains waiting and does not submit.
Inventory ARCHIVED/RESERVED/CONSUMED states are retained on legal status updates.
Existing mapping UI refreshes local summaries every 5 seconds and active background reconciliation polls every 30 seconds.
Four locales expose truthful downloaded/waiting/introduced states and exact-code diagnostics; no new opt-in UI.
No schema/dependency/version/public release changes; no real paid/signing/account business writes.
limits: Existing missing-permit parked workflow still requires document synchronization/resume.
Existing explicit manual retry behavior outside the automatic observer was not redesigned.
No Windows seller UI or real SUZ/CryptoPro acceptance in this task.
Active-product guard is not permanent retirement metadata across all future Catalog resynchronizations.

configuredCredentialScan.method: Exact comparison against configured VNCODE credential values without printing values; not a complete secret scanner.
